meta.name: altitude-horizon-framework
meta.description: Understand the PM-to-Director transition through altitude and horizon thinking. Use when diagnosing scope, time-horizon, or leadership-level gaps.

copy.tagline: 诊断管理者的视野与时间跨度差距
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从项目经理向总监转型，需要识别能力短板。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose gaps in managerial altitude and time horizon
copy.fit_line_en: For you if transitioning from PM to Director and need to identify blind spots.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用“高度”和“时间视野”两个维度帮你分析从产品经理到总监的思维转变，诊断你在哪个过渡区遇到困难，并在方向不明时帮你创建上下文地图。
howto.when: 当你描述自己的角色、过渡期的摩擦或需要决策的情况时触发。也可以直接阅读框架。

say.text: 我刚升总监，感觉不对劲，帮我诊断一下。
say.note: Claude 会分析你处于哪个过渡区。

say.text: 公司战略很模糊，团队没有方向，帮我做个上下文级联。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成六步级联地图。

say.text: 我还在做产品经理，想提前了解总监思维。
say.note: Claude 会给出过渡前的观察建议。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Altitude (scope) and Horizon (time) axes to analyze the PM-to-Director transition, diagnose which transition zone is causing friction, and apply a Cascading Context Map when organizational direction is vague.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe your role, transition friction, or a decision you're weighing. Can also be read as a standalone framework.

say_en.text: I'm a new Director and something isn't clicking — help me diagnose it.
say_en.note: Claude will identify which transition zone you're in.

say_en.text: My team has no clear direction — run a Cascading Context Map.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the six-step cascade.

say_en.text: I'm a senior PM wanting to understand the Director shift.
say_en.note: Claude will give pre-transition observation tips.
